points.heading: Reading with understanding
points.summary: Read carefully and show understanding of French words, phrases and simple writing.

points.heading: Vocabulary and dictionary skills
points.summary: Broaden French vocabulary and work out new words, including by using a bilingual dictionary.

points.heading: Conversations, questions and opinions
points.summary: Take part in conversations by asking and answering questions, giving and responding to opinions, and asking for help.

points.heading: Sounds and spelling
points.summary: Explore French sound patterns through songs and rhymes and link the spelling, sound and meaning of words.

points.heading: Stories, songs, poems and rhymes
points.summary: Enjoy and understand French stories, songs, poems and rhymes.

points.heading: Describing people, places and things
points.summary: Describe people, places, things and actions in French.

points.heading: Grammar and language patterns
points.summary: Understand basic French grammar, including masculine and feminine forms, high-frequency verbs and building sentences, and compare it with English.

points.heading: Writing sentences
points.summary: Write French phrases from memory and adapt them to make new sentences that express ideas clearly.
